items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I had some when Eli was in the band but it may have gotten away

ctx.x: Well, he wasn't first, if you came chronologically in front of him in twenty eight.
And he travelled with me. I have a picture--I had some when Eli was in the band but it may have gotten away, but I have one of Iller when he was in the band. He took Spurgeon West's place.
